bypass.pattern: def error( / def warning( / def info(
bypass.reason: FALSE POSITIVE, reported to @seedgo: cli_check substring-matches `def error(`/`def warning(`/`def info(` anywhere in a file and cannot tell a class method from a module-level display helper. The three hits are TrailLogger.error/.warning/.info — logger methods carrying the fleet's logger API on purpose, not CLI display functions. config.py is not a CLI module at all (see its cli_flags bypass) and cannot import cli.apps.modules.display at import time.
